correctness.rationale: For a nonzero finitely supported real neutral diagonal perturbation, the all-pairs distance quadratic form is strictly negative and equals minus twice the cumulative-charge energy A. The free lattice Green kernel splits into a singular rank-one term and a uniformly bounded regular matrix R with R(0)=-D/(2J). A rank-one determinant reduction and the analytic implicit-function theorem give one simple upper branch with kappa=A epsilon^2/(2J^2)+B epsilon^3/(8J^3)+O(epsilon^4); the bipartite unitary gives the lower branch and opposite quintic term. The spectral maximum is convex and bounded below by the unperturbed essential edge, extending existence at each edge to all nonzero couplings. check.py passed 5 patterns, 20 two-sign high-precision determinant comparisons and 10 finite-chain edge eigenvalue checks, while analytic reasoning establishes all supported potentials.
